newsitem.title: LATVIA: PM SAYS '97 TURNING POINT FOR FOREIGN INVESTMENT.
newsitem.headline: PM SAYS '97 TURNING POINT FOR FOREIGN INVESTMENT.

text.p: Foreign investment in Latvia will take off during 1997, Latvian Prime Minister Andris Shkele predicted in an interview with Reuters on Thursday.
"I think we will see a breakthrough this year," Shkele said.
"The biggest enterprises will be privatised, it will activate the capital market and I think the parliament will ratify a very liberal law concerning the land market."
He said infrastructure was also being improved, a factor that will help in attracting investment.
